RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday,  the December 12, 2008/Agrahayana 21, 1930 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Health and Family Welfare; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions — 20
56
Deaths due to carelessness of doctors
*161. SHRI KAMAL AKHTAR: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has paid
attention towards incidents of death of
patients and beating of doctors as a result
thereof by patients' family members accusing
them of carelessness towards patients in
reputed hospitals of the country;
(b) if so, the safety measures being taken
in this regard; and
(c) the measures being taken to check
the attitude of carelessness of doctors
towards patients and their repeated threat
of going on strike?
Exemption of export duty
*162. SHRI GIREESH KUMAR
SANGHI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI
READDY:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has asked
Government to consider exemption of
export duty on certain products like cold
rolled coils, for which raw materials have
been imported under the Advance Licensing
Scheme (ALS);
(b) if so, whether despite export duties
announced on various steel products, it
would be prudent for Government to
consider allowing duty-free export of CR
coils, galvanized steel, tubes and pipes, for
which HR coils have been imported under
ALS;
(c) whether Government has considered
roll back of export duty; and
(d) if so, by when final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
AIIMS like institutions in the North-
East
*163. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is planning to
include North East Region (NER) in its
mission of setting up AIIMS like
institutions;

57
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, reasons therefor, in so far as
AIIMS like institutions will solve the
problems of entire NER?
Income of cotton producers
†*164. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India is one
of the leading cotton producing countries
in the world;
(b) if so, the facts in this regard and the
names of five leading cotton producing
countries of the world; and
(c) per hectare income of cotton
producers from cotton production in these
countries?
Injectible polio vaccine
*165. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans to
introduce an injectible form of polio vaccine
(IPVO), along with the oral dosage, in
selected districts of U.P. and Bihar to wipe
out the virulent strain of polio virus;
(b) if so, the facts and details thereof;
(c) whether some of the foreign based
foundations have agreed to provide funds
to the Union Government for this purpose;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Functioning of rural healthcare
centres
*166. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the country's rural healthcare infrastructure
is lagging and functioning only on paper;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Supreme Court has
expressed concern over the functioning of
rural healthcare centres; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
Government proposes to take to improve
the condition of rural healthcare centres in
the country?
CAG report on Railways
*167. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of RAILW AYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether CAG has rapped the
Railways for irregularities, poor planning
and deficiencies in stores and contract
management and pointed out a loss of
Rs. 801 crore during nine months, as
Railway Board had fixed haulage rates
recoverable for container traffic on
Container Corporation of India Limited
(CONCOR) at less than the base rates;
(b) if so, whether the report also
contradicts his statement that his Ministry
is showing profit, as actually it is running
in losses; and

58
(c) if so, what are the other main points
mentioned in the audit report and what are
the steps being taken to implement the
suggestions made by the CAG?
Production and job cuts in major steel
companies
*168. SHRI R.C. SINGH: Will the
Minister of STEEL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that major steel
companies in the country have cut down
production following steep decline in
demand for the commodity and the global
economic slow down;
(b) if so, the comparative details of
production during the months of September,
October and November for the years 2007
and 2008 of both the public and private
sector companies, plant-wise;
(c) whether certain steel plants have cut
jobs also due to this reason; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
National Pharma Policy
*169. SHRI RAJEEV SHUKLA:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of CHEMICALS
AND FERTILIZERS be pleased to state:
(a) whether, even after 15 months of
National Pharma Policy being referred to a
Group of Ministers (GoM), Price control
issue failed to get resolved and has landed
in a legal tangle;
(b) if so, whether GoM has sought
clarification on a Supreme Court order of
March, 2003 and its implications;
(c) if so, whether in the GoM meeting
held in April, 2008, no decision was taken on
pharma policy, primarily on account of span
of price control on drugs which has been
interpreted as per Supreme Court order;
(d) if so, the steps Government
proposes to take; and
(e) by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken?
Child mental healthcare
*170. SHRIMA TI SUPRIYA SULE:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has agreed to accord priority to child mental
healthcare;
(b) whether in the Eleventh Five Year
Plan (2007-2012) document, the
Commission has pointed out that there is
currently no budgetary allocation for child
and adolescent mental healthcare;
(c) if so, what is the total amount of
funds the Planning Commission has agreed
to provide to the States during the next
year for this purpose; and
(d) to what extent it will be helpful in
meeting the child mental healthcare?
CAG report on disaster management
preparedness in Railways
*171. SHRI N.R. GOVINDARAJAR:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Indian Railways seriously
lack in disaster management preparedness
as per CAG's latest report;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is a fact that there is
shortage of trained manpower and proper
communication equipment and trains are
not equipped with rescue and relief
systems; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and the steps
taken by the Railways in this regard?

59
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Institutional credit to agriculture
sector
†*172. SHRI SHIVANAND TIWARI:
DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a target to
provide institutional credit worth Rs.
2,80,000 crore to the agriculture sector was
set for current financial year;
(b) if not, what was the amount;
(c) whether Government has obtained
information concerning credit given to
agriculture sector from June to the end of
September this year; and
(d) if so, the total volume thereof?
Steps to increase production of oil-
seeds and pulses
†*173. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAJ MOHINDER
SINGH MAJITHA:
Will the Minister of AGRICULTURE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that effective
steps are required to be taken for increasing
the production of oilseeds and pulses to
meet country's consumption requirement;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto;
(c) whether, in the last three years,
Government has introduced any scheme
for giving economic incentive to the
producers to increase the production of the
said crops and also to expand cultivation
area thereof; and
(d) if so, the details of the scheme and
the results achieved therefrom?
Vacant post of AIIMS Director
*174. SHRI MAHENDRA
MOHAN:
DR. (SHRIMATI) NAJMA
A. HEPTULLA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
the post of Director is lying vacant at
AIIMS since July, 2008;
(b) if so, why this post has not been
filled so far;
(c) what are the recommendations of
the V aliathan Committee for selection of
Director and what criteria has been set by
his Ministry;
(d) which recommendations of
Valiathan Committee have been
implemented by his Ministry; and
(e) the details of the recommendations
not accepted by Government?
Reduction in rice quota under PDS
*175. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has curtailed
the quantity of rice under the Public
Distribution System in the Above Poverty
Line (APL) category in different States
and Union Territories of the country
with reference to the years 2007-08 and
2008-09;
(b) if so, the names of the States and
UTs;
(c) the extent of reduction for Tripura
and Kerala; and
(d) the reasons for reduction?

60
Amendment of PC and PNDT
Act
*176. SHRIMATI MOHSINA
KIDWAI: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
sex determination tests are being conducted
by doctors at several medical centres/
hospitals illegally in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Pre-conception (PC) and
Pre-natal Diagnostic Techniques (PNDT)
Act has completely failed to check the rising
cases of its violation;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government proposes to
amend the PC and PNDT Act to make it
stringent; and
(f) if so, the details thereof?
Smuggling of foodgrains to
Bangladesh and Nepal
†*177. SHRI PRABHA T JHA: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that huge quantity
of wheat, rice and other foodgrains are being
smuggled to Nepal and Bangladesh from
the country;
(b) if so, the names of the States from
where this smuggling is taking place and
the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the Union
Government has failed to stop smuggling
inspite of having information;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the details of the steps being taken
by Government to stop smuggling?
Long-term plan for self-sufficiency in
foodgrains production
*178. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: W ill the Minister of
AGRICULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether in the absence of a long term
plan to achieve self-sufficiency in
foodgrains, the country will be a chronic
importer of foodgrains by 2020;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Government proposes to
chalk out a long term plan to achieve self-
sufficiency in the production of foodgrains
to avoid imports; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Classification of iron ores for fixing
freight charges
*179. SHRI T.T.V . DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has classified
iron ores for fixing freight charges;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether steel producers have
resented the proposal; and
(d) if so, the action taken in this regard?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

Recruitment in the Railways
*180. SHRI M.V. MYSURA REDDY:
Will the Minister of RAILWA YS be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of recruitment made in
the Railways during the last three years,
post-wise, year-wise and zone-wise;
(b) the number of candidates selected
to various posts in the Indian Railways in
the last three years, post-wise, State-wise
and year-wise;
(c) whether the Railways would face
any constraints to issue a White Paper on
the recruitment of various posts made in
various zones of the Indian Railways in
the last three years;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, whether the Ministry would
issue a White Paper on the recruitment of
various posts in the Railways?
